description: Manages records of interactions, particularly those originating from or related to Gmail communications. This entity helps in logging and tracking communications with various stakeholders.

endpoints.name: CreateInteraction
endpoints.description: Creates a new interaction record, typically initiated from a Gmail context. This allows logging communications or activities directly from email.

model.description: The interaction data to be created.

example_uses: Create a new interaction from an email.
Log a new communication with a client.
Record a new activity related to a Gmail conversation.
endpoints.when_to_use: When you need to create a new interaction record, typically initiated from a Gmail context, to log a communication or activity.

endpoints.name: UpdateInteraction
endpoints.description: Updates an existing interaction record. This allows modifying details of previously logged communications or activities.
example_uses: Update the details of an existing interaction.
Modify an interaction record to add more information.
Change the status of a logged email interaction.
endpoints.when_to_use: When you need to modify the details of an already existing interaction record, such as updating its status or adding more notes.

endpoints.name: FindGmailInteraction
endpoints.description: Finds specific Gmail interactions based on provided criteria. This endpoint allows searching for interactions using various parameters within the request body.

model.description: The criteria to search for Gmail interactions.

example_uses: Find all interactions related to a specific email thread.
Search for Gmail interactions by sender or recipient.
Locate interactions that occurred within a certain date range.
endpoints.when_to_use: When you need to search for and retrieve specific interaction records, especially those originating from Gmail, using various search criteria provided in the request body.

endpoints.name: FindRelatedRecords
endpoints.description: Finds records related to a given Gmail context, such as contacts, partners, or other entities linked to an email. This helps in identifying existing relationships based on email content.

input.description: The input data to find related records.

example_uses: Find contacts related to the current email.
Discover partners associated with this email conversation.
Identify any existing records linked to the email content.
endpoints.when_to_use: When you need to identify and retrieve records (e.g., contacts, partners, projects) that are related to the context of a specific Gmail email or conversation.

endpoints.name: CreateRecordsFromEmails
endpoints.description: Creates new records (e.g., interactions, contacts, partners) based on information extracted from one or more emails. This automates the process of logging information from emails into the system.

request.description: The request containing email data to create records from.

example_uses: Generate new interaction records from a selection of emails.
Create new contact entries directly from email addresses.
Automate the creation of business records from email content.
endpoints.when_to_use: When you need to automatically create various types of records (like interactions, contacts, or partners) by processing information extracted from one or more emails.
